propositions: Nested pytest children launched without private --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and delete cleanup-eligible trees from unrelated runs

Tests test_engine_submodules_resolve_when_the_tests_unit_shadow_is_active and test_repro_module_passes_standalone launch executing nested pytest without parent-owned basetemp, causing uncontrolled cleanup
Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp allocates and registers numbered-root cleanup, while pytest_sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None
Repair assigns each nested child a unique tmp_path subdirectory via --basetemp to localize cleanup and prevent deletion of unrelated temp trees
The three collect-only nested launchers and pytester-managed launches are safe because they either never allocate TempPathFactory._basetemp or already receive basetemp from helpers
